A former Hamas bodyguard was identified after being granted British citizenship and alleged to have plotted a terror attack. item.description:
Iran struck a U.S. military radar in Bahrain and launched drones that were shot down, while the United States responded by hitting Iran's Qeshm Island and disabling a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Iran also hit a building in Tel Aviv with a missile and opened a women’s war-readiness training camp, and it designated the Argentine navy and air force as terrorist organisations, warning of retaliation against European bases hosting U.S. forces. Qatar reported progress in U.S., Iran talks after a White House meeting, and France blamed Iran for a cyberattack on refrigeration systems. The crisis now includes a planned trilateral meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin in China. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

In Yemen, Houthi shelling of a refugee camp in Lahj killed a Somali woman and attacks in Taiz killed 51 people and wounded 85, according to a rights group. Pakistan has urged an immediate end to Houthi attacks as the UN Security Council renews Yemen sanctions, and France’s foreign ministry spokesperson says France favours adding pressure on the Houthis. item.description:

item.description:
The Sudanese army has seized Bakori and Sali in West Kordofan and recaptured Al-Khuwai and other areas in West and North Kordofan from the RSF, while the RSF continues drone strikes that killed nine civilians in the Blue Nile. The army shot down an RSF drone that crossed from Ethiopia, adding to reports of drones being launched across the border. Gold smuggled from Sudan is being routed through Ethiopia to the UAE, which remains the main destination for the illicit metal. Turkish support for the SAF is linked to ports, minerals and military bases. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Governors in Jonglei and Aweil East called for peace ahead of the delayed vote. An ambush on a convoy killed two people, including a journalist, and a CityLink Aviation plane crashed near Juba, killing all 14 aboard. Ethiopian drones are now operating over Sudan and RSF drones are launching from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. Drone and artillery strikes have been reported between Ethiopia and Eritrea near Badme, and cross-border attacks have spilled into Kenya, displacing thousands and killing civilians in Moyale. An RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
